title: path dependency blocks upload
fix: Replace `path:` with a hosted constraint, e.g. `my_pkg: ^1.2.0`, after publishing my_pkg first.

title: git dependency blocks upload
fix: Replace `git:` with a hosted constraint from pub.dev, e.g. `my_pkg: ^1.2.0`.

title: dependency_overrides are ignored by every user of the package
fix: Delete the dependency_overrides block before publishing and widen the real constraint under dependencies instead.

title: publish_to: none prevents publication
fix: Remove `publish_to: none` if this package is meant for pub.dev.

title: package name must be [a-z0-9_] and not start with a digit
fix: Rename to lowercase with underscores, e.g. `geo_helpers`.

title: version must be three numbers separated by dots
fix: Write a full semantic version, e.g. `version: 1.4.0`.

title: description should be 60 to 180 characters
fix: Write one plain-text sentence of 60-180 characters saying what the package does.

title: environment: sdk constraint is required
fix: Add `environment:` with `  sdk: ^3.0.0` (or your real minimum).

title: no homepage or repository
fix: Add `repository: https://github.com/<you>/<pkg>` so pub.dev links the source and issue tracker.

title: topics: at most 5, each 2-32 chars, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter
fix: Keep 5 topics or fewer, e.g. `topics: [maps, geolocation]`.
